list.name: customer_id
list.label: Customer
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, name AS __text FROM customers ORDER BY name

list.name: router
list.label: Router
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, identity_name AS __text FROM routers WHERE customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY identity_name

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "value" FROM routers WHERE customer_id = $customer_id AND (last_seen_at IS NULL OR last_seen_at < now() - interval '15 minutes')

SELECT avg(jitter) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pm.router_id, pm.target_name) pm.jitter_ms AS jitter FROM path_metrics pm JOIN routers r ON r.id = pm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY pm.router_id, pm.target_name, pm.time DESC) latest

SELECT r.identity_name AS "Router", r.mgmt_host AS "Mgmt Host", rf.board_name AS "Model", rf.architecture AS "Arch", rf.routeros_version AS "RouterOS", rf.current_firmware AS "Board Firmware", rf.latest_routeros_version AS "Latest RouterOS", rf.update_status AS "Update Status", rm.uptime AS "Uptime", r.last_seen_at AS "Last Seen", CASE WHEN r.last_seen_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' THEN 'online' ELSE 'offline' END AS "Status" FROM routers r LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT uptime FROM router_metrics WHERE router_id = r.id ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) rm ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT board_name, architecture, routeros_version, current_firmware, latest_routeros_version, update_status FROM router_firmware WHERE router_id = r.id ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) rf ON true WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY r.identity_name

WITH deltas AS (SELECT uplink_label, time, rx_bytes - LAG(rx_bytes) OVER (PARTITION BY uplink_label ORDER BY time) AS rx_delta, tx_bytes - LAG(tx_bytes) OVER (PARTITION BY uplink_label ORDER BY time) AS tx_delta, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY uplink_label ORDER BY time))) AS seconds_elapsed FROM uplink_metrics WHERE router_id = $router AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS "time", uplink_label || ' download' AS metric, CASE WHEN max(rx_delta) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(max(rx_delta), 0) * 8 / NULLIF(max(seconds_elapsed), 0) END AS value FROM deltas GROUP BY 1, uplink_label UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz), uplink_label || ' upload', CASE WHEN max(tx_delta) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(max(tx_delta), 0) * 8 / NULLIF(max(seconds_elapsed), 0) END FROM deltas GROUP BY 1, uplink_label ORDER BY 1

WITH deltas AS (SELECT um.router_id, um.uplink_label, um.time, um.rx_bytes - LAG(um.rx_bytes) OVER (PARTITION BY um.router_id, um.uplink_label ORDER BY um.time) AS rx_delta, um.tx_bytes - LAG(um.tx_bytes) OVER (PARTITION BY um.router_id, um.uplink_label ORDER BY um.time) AS tx_delta, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (um.time - LAG(um.time) OVER (PARTITION BY um.router_id, um.uplink_label ORDER BY um.time))) AS seconds_elapsed FROM uplink_metrics um JOIN routers r ON r.id = um.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id AND $__timeFilter(um.time)) SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS "time", sum(CASE WHEN rx_delta IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(rx_delta, 0) * 8 / NULLIF(seconds_elapsed, 0) END) AS "download_bps", sum(CASE WHEN tx_delta IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(tx_delta, 0) * 8 / NULLIF(seconds_elapsed, 0) END) AS "upload_bps" FROM deltas GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (pm.router_id, pm.target_name) r.identity_name AS "Router", pm.target_name || ' (' || pm.target_host || ')' AS "Target", pm.rtt_avg_ms AS "Avg RTT (ms)", pm.jitter_ms AS "Jitter (ms)", pm.packet_loss_pct AS "Loss %", pm.time AS "As of" FROM path_metrics pm JOIN routers r ON r.id = pm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id AND pm.target_name IN ('cloudflare-dns', 'google-dns', 'facebook.com', 'google.com') ORDER BY pm.router_id, pm.target_name, pm.time DESC

SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS "time", target_name || ' latency' AS metric, avg(rtt_avg_ms) AS value FROM path_metrics WHERE router_id = $router AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, target_name UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz), target_name || ' jitter', avg(jitter_ms) FROM path_metrics WHERE router_id = $router AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, target_name ORDER BY 1

SELECT "Router", "Interface", "Link", "FCS Errors", "RX Too Short", "RX Too Long", "RX Overflow", "Collisions", "Late Collisions", "TX Underrun", "As of" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (im.router_id, im.interface_name) r.identity_name AS "Router", im.interface_name AS "Interface", CASE WHEN im.running THEN 'up' ELSE 'down' END AS "Link", im.rx_fcs_error AS "FCS Errors", im.rx_too_short AS "RX Too Short", im.rx_too_long AS "RX Too Long", im.rx_overflow AS "RX Overflow", im.tx_collision AS "Collisions", im.tx_late_collision AS "Late Collisions", im.tx_underrun AS "TX Underrun", im.time AS "As of" FROM interface_metrics im JOIN routers r ON r.id = im.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY im.router_id, im.interface_name, im.time DESC) sub WHERE "FCS Errors" > 0 OR "RX Too Short" > 0 OR "RX Too Long" > 0 OR "RX Overflow" > 0 OR "Collisions" > 0 OR "Late Collisions" > 0 OR "TX Underrun" > 0 ORDER BY "Router", "Interface"

WITH deltas AS (SELECT interface_name, time, rx_fcs_error - LAG(rx_fcs_error) OVER (PARTITION BY interface_name ORDER BY time) AS fcs_delta, tx_collision - LAG(tx_collision) OVER (PARTITION BY interface_name ORDER BY time) AS collision_delta FROM interface_metrics WHERE router_id = $router AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS "time", interface_name || ' FCS errors' AS metric, CASE WHEN max(fcs_delta) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(max(fcs_delta), 0) END AS value FROM deltas GROUP BY 1, interface_name UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz), interface_name || ' collisions', CASE WHEN max(collision_delta) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(max(collision_delta), 0) END FROM deltas GROUP BY 1, interface_name ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', rm.time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS "time", r.identity_name || ' CPU %' AS metric, avg(rm.cpu_load_pct) AS value FROM router_metrics rm JOIN routers r ON r.id = rm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id AND $__timeFilter(rm.time) GROUP BY 1, r.identity_name UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', rm.time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz), r.identity_name || ' RAM %', avg(CASE WHEN rm.ram_total_bytes > 0 THEN 100.0 * rm.ram_used_bytes / rm.ram_total_bytes END) FROM router_metrics rm JOIN routers r ON r.id = rm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id AND $__timeFilter(rm.time) GROUP BY 1, r.identity_name UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', rm.time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz), r.identity_name || ' Disk %', avg(CASE WHEN rm.disk_total_bytes > 0 THEN 100.0 * rm.disk_used_bytes / rm.disk_total_bytes END) FROM router_metrics rm JOIN routers r ON r.id = rm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id AND $__timeFilter(rm.time) GROUP BY 1, r.identity_name ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS "time", core_name AS metric, avg(load_pct) AS value FROM cpu_core_metrics WHERE router_id = $router AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, core_name ORDER BY 1

SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (dm.router_id, dm.pool_name) r.identity_name AS "Router", dm.pool_name AS "Pool", dm.active_leases AS "Active", dm.total_addresses AS "Total", dm.utilization_pct AS "Util %", dm.time AS "As of" FROM dhcp_pool_metrics dm JOIN routers r ON r.id = dm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY dm.router_id, dm.pool_name, dm.time DESC) latest ORDER BY "Util %" DESC

SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', cm.time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS "time", count(DISTINCT cm.client_mac) AS "clients" FROM client_metrics cm JOIN sites s ON s.id = cm.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND $__timeFilter(cm.time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', cm.time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS "time", avg(cm.signal) AS "avg_signal", avg(cm.satisfaction) AS "avg_satisfaction", 100.0 * sum(cm.tx_retries) / NULLIF(sum(cm.wifi_tx_attempts), 0) AS "retry_pct" FROM client_metrics cm JOIN sites s ON s.id = cm.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND $__timeFilter(cm.time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ai.ap_mac) ai.ap_name AS "AP", CASE WHEN ai.state = 1 THEN 'online' ELSE 'offline' END AS "Status", ai.satisfaction AS "Satisfaction", ai.num_sta AS "Clients", ai.model AS "Model", ai.version AS "Firmware", ai.cpu_pct AS "CPU %", ai.mem_pct AS "Mem %", ai.channel_util_2g AS "2.4G Util", ai.channel_util_5g AS "5G Util", c.base_url || '/manage/site/' || s.unifi_site_name || '/dashboard' AS "Controller URL", ai.time AS "As of" FROM ap_inventory ai JOIN sites s ON s.id = ai.site_id JOIN controllers c ON c.id = s.controller_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY ai.ap_mac, ai.time DESC) latest ORDER BY "Status", "AP"

SELECT r.id AS router_id, r.identity_name AS "Router", cs.time AS "Captured", cs.size_bytes AS "Size (bytes)" FROM router_config_snapshots cs JOIN routers r ON r.id = cs.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY cs.time DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT round(100.0 * conntrack_count / NULLIF(conntrack_max,0), 1) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (rm.router_id) rm.conntrack_count, rm.conntrack_max FROM router_metrics rm JOIN routers r ON r.id = rm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY rm.router_id, rm.time DESC) latest ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT avg(loss) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pm.router_id, pm.target_name) pm.packet_loss_pct AS loss FROM path_metrics pm JOIN routers r ON r.id = pm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY pm.router_id, pm.target_name, pm.time DESC) latest

SELECT avg(rtt) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pm.router_id, pm.target_name) pm.rtt_avg_ms AS rtt FROM path_metrics pm JOIN routers r ON r.id = pm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY pm.router_id, pm.target_name, pm.time DESC) latest

SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (hm.router_id, hm.gauge_name) r.identity_name AS "Router", hm.gauge_name AS "Gauge", hm.value AS "Value", hm.unit AS "Unit", hm.time AS "As of" FROM health_metrics hm JOIN routers r ON r.id = hm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY hm.router_id, hm.gauge_name, hm.time DESC) latest ORDER BY "Router", "Gauge"

SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', time, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS "time", gauge_name AS metric, avg(CASE WHEN value ~ '^[0-9.]+$' THEN value::numeric END) AS value FROM health_metrics WHERE router_id = $router AND $__timeFilter(time) AND (gauge_name LIKE '%temperature%' OR gauge_name LIKE '%speed%') GROUP BY 1, gauge_name ORDER BY 1

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (cm.site_id, cm.client_mac) cm.site_id, cm.ap_mac, ai.ap_name AS ap_name, cm.client_mac, cm.hostname, cm.essid, cm.signal, cm.noise, (cm.signal - cm.noise) AS snr, cm.satisfaction, 100.0 * cm.tx_retries / NULLIF(cm.wifi_tx_attempts, 0) AS retry_pct, cm.tx_rate / 1000 AS tx_rate_mbps, cm.channel, cm.time, ctrl.base_url || '/manage/site/' || s.unifi_site_name || '/dashboard' AS controller_url FROM client_metrics cm JOIN sites s ON s.id = cm.site_id JOIN controllers ctrl ON ctrl.id = s.controller_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ap_name FROM ap_inventory WHERE ap_mac = cm.ap_mac ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) ai ON true WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND cm.time > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY cm.site_id, cm.client_mac, cm.time DESC), problems AS (SELECT *, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ap_mac, channel) AS peers_on_same_channel FROM latest WHERE retry_pct > 20 OR satisfaction < 80 OR signal < -75) SELECT ap_name AS "AP", client_mac AS "Client", hostname AS "Device", essid AS "SSID", CASE WHEN peers_on_same_channel >= 3 THEN 'Channel congestion (' || peers_on_same_channel || ' affected)' WHEN snr < 15 THEN 'Weak signal / interference' WHEN snr >= 15 AND tx_rate_mbps IS NOT NULL AND tx_rate_mbps < 24 THEN 'Legacy device / rate issue' WHEN retry_pct > 20 THEN 'Elevated retries -- check UniFi UI' ELSE 'Unclear -- check UniFi UI' END AS "Likely Cause", signal AS "Signal (dBm)", noise AS "Noise (dBm)", snr AS "SNR (dB)", satisfaction AS "Satisfaction", round(retry_pct,1) AS "Retry %", tx_rate_mbps AS "TX Rate (Mbps)", channel AS "Channel", controller_url AS "Controller URL", time AS "As of" FROM problems ORDER BY retry_pct DESC NULLS LAST

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (cm.site_id, cm.client_mac) cm.signal, cm.noise, cm.satisfaction, 100.0 * cm.tx_retries / NULLIF(cm.wifi_tx_attempts, 0) AS retry_pct FROM client_metrics cm JOIN sites s ON s.id = cm.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND cm.time > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY cm.site_id, cm.client_mac, cm.time DESC) SELECT count(*) AS "value" FROM latest WHERE retry_pct > 20 OR satisfaction < 80 OR signal < -75

SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 1) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ai.ap_mac) ai.state FROM ap_inventory ai JOIN sites s ON s.id = ai.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND ai.time > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY ai.ap_mac, ai.time DESC) latest

SELECT count(*) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ai.ap_mac) ai.state FROM ap_inventory ai JOIN sites s ON s.id = ai.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND ai.time > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY ai.ap_mac, ai.time DESC) latest WHERE state != 1 OR state IS NULL

SELECT round(avg(100.0 * tx_retries / NULLIF(wifi_tx_attempts, 0)), 1) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (cm.site_id, cm.client_mac) cm.tx_retries, cm.wifi_tx_attempts FROM client_metrics cm JOIN sites s ON s.id = cm.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND cm.time > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY cm.site_id, cm.client_mac, cm.time DESC) latest

SELECT max(cpu_load_pct) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (rm.router_id) rm.cpu_load_pct FROM router_metrics rm JOIN routers r ON r.id = rm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY rm.router_id, rm.time DESC) latest

SELECT count(DISTINCT router_id) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (hm.router_id, hm.gauge_name) hm.router_id, hm.gauge_name, hm.value FROM health_metrics hm JOIN routers r ON r.id = hm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY hm.router_id, hm.gauge_name, hm.time DESC) latest WHERE (gauge_name LIKE 'psu%-state' AND value != 'ok') OR (gauge_name = 'fan-state' AND value != 'ok')

SELECT max(utilization_pct) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (dm.router_id, dm.pool_name) dm.utilization_pct FROM dhcp_pool_metrics dm JOIN routers r ON r.id = dm.router_id WHERE r.customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY dm.router_id, dm.pool_name, dm.time DESC) latest

targets.expr: {job="mikrotik_syslog", host="${router:text}"} |~ `(user \S+ logged (in|out) from \S+ via \S+|login failure for user \S+ from \S+ via \S+)`
count_over_time({job="mikrotik_syslog", host="${router:text}"} |~ `login failure for user \S+ from \S+ via \S+` [1h])

panels.title: Offline APs (detail)
panels.description: APs whose controller reports them as anything other than connected, within the last 15 minutes -- the same population the APs Offline card counts. Click an AP name to open its site in the UniFi controller.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ap_name AS "AP", site_label AS "Site", model AS "Model", version AS "Firmware", num_sta AS "Last Client Count", time AS "Last Report", controller_url AS "Controller URL" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ai.ap_mac) ai.ap_name, COALESCE(s.site_desc, s.unifi_site_name) AS site_label, ai.model, ai.version, ai.num_sta, ai.state, ai.time, c.base_url || '/manage/site/' || s.unifi_site_name || '/devices' AS controller_url FROM ap_inventory ai JOIN sites s ON s.id = ai.site_id JOIN controllers c ON c.id = s.controller_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND ai.time > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY ai.ap_mac, ai.time DESC) latest WHERE state != 1 OR state IS NULL ORDER BY site_label, ap_name

panels.title: Wi-Fi Clients Connected
panels.description: Wireless clients seen in the last 15 minutes, across all this customer's sites/controllers.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (cm.site_id, cm.client_mac) cm.is_wired, cm.satisfaction, cm.signal, cm.noise, cm.radio, cm.tx_rate FROM client_metrics cm JOIN sites s ON s.id = cm.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND cm.time > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY cm.site_id, cm.client_mac, cm.time DESC) latest WHERE is_wired = false

panels.title: Avg Satisfaction
panels.description: Mean of UniFi's own per-client experience score (0-100) over currently-connected wireless clients.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(satisfaction)::numeric, 1) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (cm.site_id, cm.client_mac) cm.is_wired, cm.satisfaction, cm.signal, cm.noise, cm.radio, cm.tx_rate FROM client_metrics cm JOIN sites s ON s.id = cm.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND cm.time > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY cm.site_id, cm.client_mac, cm.time DESC) latest WHERE is_wired = false AND satisfaction IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Avg SNR
panels.description: Mean signal-to-noise ratio across wireless clients -- the real link-quality number; good signal on a noisy channel still performs badly.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(signal - noise)::numeric, 1) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (cm.site_id, cm.client_mac) cm.is_wired, cm.satisfaction, cm.signal, cm.noise, cm.radio, cm.tx_rate FROM client_metrics cm JOIN sites s ON s.id = cm.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND cm.time > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY cm.site_id, cm.client_mac, cm.time DESC) latest WHERE is_wired = false AND signal IS NOT NULL AND noise IS NOT NULL

panels.title: 2.4GHz Client Share
panels.description: Share of wireless clients on 2.4GHz. A rising share means clients are falling off 5GHz (coverage gaps, band-steering misconfig, legacy devices) onto the slower, more congested band.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE radio = 'ng') / NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (cm.site_id, cm.client_mac) cm.is_wired, cm.satisfaction, cm.signal, cm.noise, cm.radio, cm.tx_rate FROM client_metrics cm JOIN sites s ON s.id = cm.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND cm.time > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY cm.site_id, cm.client_mac, cm.time DESC) latest WHERE is_wired = false AND radio IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Peak Channel Util 2.4G
panels.description: Highest 2.4GHz airtime utilization on any single AP radio right now -- congestion at the radio level, before it shows up as retries.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(channel_util_2g) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ai.ap_mac) ai.channel_util_2g, ai.channel_util_5g FROM ap_inventory ai JOIN sites s ON s.id = ai.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND ai.time > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY ai.ap_mac, ai.time DESC) latest

panels.title: Peak Channel Util 5G
panels.description: Highest 5GHz airtime utilization on any single AP radio right now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(channel_util_5g) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ai.ap_mac) ai.channel_util_2g, ai.channel_util_5g FROM ap_inventory ai JOIN sites s ON s.id = ai.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND ai.time > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY ai.ap_mac, ai.time DESC) latest

panels.title: Low-Rate Clients
panels.description: Wireless clients negotiating a TX rate under 24 Mbps -- legacy or edge-of-coverage devices that consume disproportionate airtime and slow the whole AP down.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "value" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (cm.site_id, cm.client_mac) cm.is_wired, cm.satisfaction, cm.signal, cm.noise, cm.radio, cm.tx_rate FROM client_metrics cm JOIN sites s ON s.id = cm.site_id WHERE s.customer_id = $customer_id AND cm.time > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY cm.site_id, cm.client_mac, cm.time DESC) latest WHERE is_wired = false AND tx_rate > 0 AND tx_rate < 24000
